name: Maejima Hitomi
source:
The beautiful dark-haired girl who is your new stepsister. A quiet girl with large, solemn eyes and a calming personality, nevertheless she possesses a deep sadness, too. What is the secret behind this incredible girl? 

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140909150929/http://www.jlist.com/product/GC024]J-List[/url]]
